document.judul: Updates in the management of hypertension
document.ringkasan:
Hypertension is the leading cause of cardiovascular diseases and nephropathies. Its treatment and management require long-term
follow-up which can be facilitated by the emergence of device-based therapies. Novel recommendations have been well described
in the latest ESH guidelines as well as new risk factors have been identiﬁed. Conclusion
Conducting blood pressure measurements in a clinical setting is a
fundamental initial step for accurately diagnosing hypertension
and tracking its progression.
